params.amount: Per-recipient amount for ALLOWLIST drops (0 otherwise).
params.merkleProof: Proof for ALLOWLIST gating (empty for other types).

params._usdc: USDC token address on this chain.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

claim(uint256,bytes32[],uint256).notice: Claim USDC from a drop.   PUBLIC / MYSTERY drops  — pass merkleProof = [] and amount = 0.   ALLOWLIST gated drops   — pass the recipient's Merkle proof and their                             individually assigned amount.   NFT / TOKEN gated drops — pass merkleProof = [] and amount = 0.

createDrop((uint8,uint8,uint256,uint256,.notice: Create and fund a new USDC drop.         Caller must approve totalAmount USDC to this contract first.

getClaimableAmount(uint256,address).notice: Preview claimable USDC for a wallet.         Returns 0 for ALLOWLIST drops (amount comes from off-chain manifest).

platformFeeBps().notice: Platform fee in basis points (100 bps = 1%). Max 5%.

refund(uint256).notice: Refund all unclaimed USDC to the creator.

usdc().notice: USDC token address on this chain (immutable).

verifyProof(uint256,address,uint256,byte.notice: Verify an ALLOWLIST proof without sending a transaction.
